evidence.note: Proposes SCALER, a coarse-to-fine LLM-based time-series forecaster that first predicts a lightweight global shape and then uses it to guide cheaper, fixed-step test-time refinement of the full-resolution forecast.
evidence.title: Efficient Test-Time Scaling for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting

name: fixed-step (schedule-based) refinement vs. reward-model candidate selection
